Container.Name: AI Studio PG Bridge
Container.Overview: OpenAI and Gemini compatible AI Studio relay gateway with a local proof server.
Container.Description: Optional prefilled form for the direct Unraid Docker Add Container flow. The relay gateway and proof server run in one container. Cookie files and the mint ledger are stored in appdata. Only the relay port is published.

Config.Name: Relay Web/API port
Config.Description: Relay dashboard and OpenAI/Gemini compatible API port. Point Caddy to this host port.

Config.Name: Cookie data
Config.Description: Persistent Google AI Studio cookie account files. Treat this directory as secret data.

Config.Name: Relay API key
Config.Description: Required key for dashboard login and API Bearer authentication. Generate a long random value and keep it private.

Config.Name: Relay host
Config.Description: Listen on all container interfaces so Docker can publish the port.

Config.Name: Default model
Config.Description: Model used when an API request does not specify one.

Config.Name: Cookie directory
Config.Description: Relative to the relay project directory inside the image.

Config.Name: Auto start proof server
Config.Description: Start the local proof server as a child process.

Config.Name: Proof host
Config.Description: Proof server stays private inside the container.

Config.Name: Proof port
Config.Description: Internal proof server port. Do not publish this port.

Config.Name: Mint ledger file
Config.Description: Path for the proof mint ledger inside the mounted data directory.
